title: The road washed out
text: Last night's rain has carried away a stretch of the road: a raw gully of mud and stones where the ruts were.

success.text: Mud to the knees, but you're across.

fail.text: You go down in the mud and come up filthy and bruised.

choices.label: Wait for the water to drop (two hours)

effects.text: By the afternoon it's only mud.
